SELECTED_INDEX: 9
CONFIDENCE: 0.64
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a strong C=C stretch at 1661 cm⁻¹ and sp² C–H stretches up to ~3083 cm⁻¹, consistent with an alkene. Key halogen signatures support a vinylic C–F/C–Br system: strong bands at 1024 and 1074 cm⁻¹ match C–F stretching, and bands at 535–560 cm⁻¹ match C–Br stretching. A =CH out-of-plane wag near 999 cm⁻¹ is also present. The absence of a strong 1700–1800 cm⁻¹ carbonyl band and lack of an OH stretch argue against ester/acid chloride/alcohol candidates. These features align best with CC/C=C(\F)Br (candidate 9).
